headline: Filatex India Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Filatex India Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of 1,30,00,000 Equity Shares of Ecosis Limited (formerly known as Texfil Private Limited), Wholly Owned Subsidiary Company.
